literal_meaning: পরস্পর টানাহেঁচড়া বা জড়াজড়ি করে ছটফটানি
figurative_meaning_en: Mutual grabbing and tussling in a fight; hand-to-hand scuffle
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বন্ধু খেলার সময় ঝটাপটি শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The kids are tussling in the mud.
The two friends started scuffling during the game.
note: This idiom is often used to describe playful or minor fights, especially among children, capturing the chaotic sounds of close-quarters struggle in Bengali everyday speech.
